rank.name: Allowing forks
rank.description: Moves that let one enemy piece attack two of yours.

rank.name: Hanging pieces
rank.description: Leaving a piece or pawn en prise, so the opponent simply takes it.

rank.name: Mating attacks against you
rank.description: Blunders that allow a forced mate.

rank.name: Pins and skewers
rank.description: Moves that walk into a pin or a skewer.

rank.name: Defending worse positions
rank.description: Blunders while already worse (10-35%), which turn a fight into a loss.

rank.name: Converting better positions
rank.description: Blunders while you were clearly better (65-90% winning chance).

rank.name: Discovered attacks
rank.description: Missing that moving one enemy piece unmasks another (incl. double check).

rank.name: Deflection, attraction and sacrifices
rank.description: Allowing combinations that need a sacrifice or remove a defender.

rank.name: Endgame technique
rank.description: Blunders after the endgame starts (six or fewer pieces).

rank.name: Calculation on long thinks
rank.description: Blunders on moves where you spent 8 seconds or more.

rank.name: Missed punishments
rank.description: The opponent just blundered and your reply let the chance go.

rank.name: Passed pawns and promotion
rank.description: Underestimating advanced pawns and promotion threats.
